title: The Understudy WIP
description: Work-in-progress build of The Understudy, a new playable character for Slay the Spire 2. Shared for friend testing. Requires BaseLib.
changeNote: v1.12.49: Best of Both now passes negative Vigor to the enemies as well as inverting it, matching regular Swap - previously sign-flip debuffs were inverted on you but never handed over. Stable is also much harder to break: Master Form (and Hidden Gem / Sword Sage) can no longer grant Replay to a Stable card, enemy afflictions like Hexed, Bound and Entangled can no longer stick to one, and in-combat upgrades such as Armaments now skip it (rest-site upgrades still work).
